items.summary: On October 5, 2026, scientists Karl Deisseroth, Peter Hegemann, and Georg Nagel were awarded the Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine for their development of optogenetics. Their groundbreaking research uses light to control individual brain cells, revolutionizing neuroscience and paving the way for advanced treatments of brain disorders.

items.headline: France Rallies with Late Goal Surge to Defeat Belgium in Nations League
items.summary: France delivered a dramatic second-half comeback to beat Belgium 4–1 in their UEFA Nations League Group A1 fixture on October 5. After trailing for much of the match, the French squad scored four unanswered goals in the final quarter-hour at the Stade de France to solidify their place at the top of the group.

items.headline: Tom Cruise Satire 'Digger' Stumbles at Box Office as 'Verity' Wins Weekend
items.summary: Amazon MGM's psychological thriller Verity topped the North American box office with a $32.6 million weekend debut. In contrast, Tom Cruise's big-budget satire Digger opened to just $8 million, marking a rare box office misfire during Warner Bros. Discovery's final release before its merger with Paramount Skydance.
